about.title: A reputation earned one customer at a time since 1988.
text: We are a full-service electrical contracting firm in the commercial, municipal and residential fields. Our reputation has been earned slowly and with considerable effort, one customer at a time, since 1988. We are proud of it and guard it jealously.
We approach each job with the same care and consideration as we did the very first one. We learn from old experience and from new technology, but the commitment to excellence remains the same.

Larry W. Tharp founded the company and still runs project management, electrical design, administrative duties, governmental compliance, insurance procurement and customer relations. He has more than 40 years of experience in electrical construction and repair, and before state-wide licensing came into effect he held over 15 individual masters licenses. He is a longtime Baytown resident who attended Lee College right here in town.
